result.summary: Detects and logs the MinGW-w64 toolchain version during CMake configuration when cross-compiling for Windows. A new CMake module parses the version macros from `_mingw_mac.h` and appends the version to the build configuration summary.
result.problem: Cross-compiled Windows binary behavior depends heavily on the MinGW-w64 toolchain version, but determining the exact version in use can be difficult when not using distro-provided packages, complicating debugging of toolchain-specific issues.
evidence: Author notes that identifying the exact toolchain version simplifies debugging toolchain-related behavior issues, citing PR #34578 where toolchain differences caused debugging friction.
result.scope_notes: Adds a standalone CMake module `GetMingwVersion.cmake` and hooks it into `CMakeLists.txt`.
result.card: This pull request detects and reports the MinGW-w64 version during CMake configuration when cross-compiling for Windows. Determining the exact MinGW-w64 version can be difficult when using custom or non-distro toolchains, which complicates troubleshooting platform-specific build and runtime issues. The author cites debugging difficulties in PR #34578 as motivation for logging this information automatically. It has no dependencies.
